title: Northeast India Real Historical Landslide Map Source Integration Report

authoritativeDataset.source: Geological Survey of India (GSI) - National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) Northeast Region Inventory
authoritativeDataset.regionalCoverage: All 8 Northeast Region (NER) states covered with field-validated coordinates

nasaDatasetHandling.status: Preserved without deletion in MongoDB collection landslideevents
nasaDatasetHandling.isolationMechanism: Filtered out from Risk Map NER Historical layer via backend query parameter ?region=NER and client-side filter (region !== 'HIMACHAL'). NASA records remain accessible for comparative testing and provenance but are prevented from masquerading as NER events.

apiAndDataFlowChanges.backendModel: src/models/LandslideEvent.js - added 'GSI', 'NRSC', 'NASA' to source enum; added state, district, region fields; indexed on { region: 1, isHistorical: 1 } and { 'locationPoint': '2dsphere' }.
apiAndDataFlowChanges.backendController: src/controllers/landslideEventController.js - enhanced getAllEvents with query filters for region (NER exclusion of NASA records), source, state, and isHistorical.
apiAndDataFlowChanges.frontendService: frontend/src/services/landslideEventService.js - supports query parameters (region, source, state, isHistorical).
apiAndDataFlowChanges.frontendDensityClassifier: frontend/src/utils/historicalRiskDensity.js - added O(N) spatial grid acceleration (0.12° cells) for datasets > 300 records, maintaining 100% mathematical parity with Haversine distance while executing in 43ms for 10,236 points.
apiAndDataFlowChanges.frontendRiskMap: frontend/src/pages/RiskMap.jsx - fetches getAllEvents({ region: 'NER' }); renders real GSI NER historical markers with Leaflet preferCanvas={true} acceleration; popups show GSI NLSM provenance, state, district, and past activity disclaimer.

semanticIntegrity.markerMeaning: Historical Landslide Activity (past documented inventory records)
semanticIntegrity.mandatoryDisclaimer: Historical records represent documented past activity and are not evidence of current hazard.
semanticIntegrity.modalSeparation: Strict separation between Historical mode (past activity catalog) and Current mode (live telemetry & ML assessment).
semanticIntegrity.earlyWarningIndependence: Historical catalog records do not trigger early warning alerts (WATCH, WARNING, CRITICAL) or active hazard levels.

thresholdPolicy.nextStep: A subsequent statistical audit will determine data-driven density thresholds specifically calibrated for the NER spatial distribution.

details: 1 & 2: Ingests and returns real NER historical records with valid coordinates (PASS)
3: Preserves NER state coverage across all 8 states (PASS)
4: NASA Himachal records are excluded from region=NER query and distinguished by source (PASS)
5 & 6: Historical records represent past activity and do not alter current mode queries (PASS)
1 & 2: Requests { region: 'NER' } and renders real NER records with valid coordinates (PASS)
3: Validates coverage across all 8 Northeast Region states (PASS)
4: Strictly excludes NASA / Himachal records from NER Historical markers (PASS)
5: Historical markers display GSI NLSM provenance, past activity tag, and disclaimer (PASS)
6: Historical ↔ Current mode separation remains completely intact (PASS)

limitations: Presence of historical records documents where failures occurred and were mapped; absence of records in remote terrain does not prove landslides never occurred (observational/reporting bias inherent to ground and aerial surveys).
Density thresholds (80, 20, 3) remain at their initial baseline and will be statistically recalibrated for the NER dataset in a subsequent audit.
